bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
echo PROJECT_ROOT_PRESENT="$(test -d "$root/.git" && echo YES || echo NO)"
if test -d "$root/.git"; then echo PROJECT_HEAD="$(git -C "$root" rev-parse --short=12 HEAD)"; fi
mapfile -t ids < <(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs)
echo GAYBBS_CONTAINER_COUNT="${#ids[@]}"
test "${#ids[@]}" -eq 1 || exit 66
cid="${ids[0]}"
echo GAYBBS_RUNNING="$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$cid")"
echo GAYBBS_IMAGE="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Config.Image}}' "$cid")"
echo GAYBBS_IMAGE_ID="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$cid" | cut -c1-20)"
docker exec "$cid" sh -c 'if grep -Fq "startPayload===\"link\"" /app/gaybbs.mjs; then echo LINK_START_ROUTER=PRESENT; else echo LINK_START_ROUTER=NOT_FOUND; fi; if grep -Fq "dm:link" /app/gaybbs.mjs; then echo LINK_DM_CALLBACK=PRESENT; else echo LINK_DM_CALLBACK=NOT_FOUND; fi' || true
echo LINK_PANEL_DB_BEGIN
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT chat_id||'|'||message_thread_id||'|'||state||'|'||COALESCE(message_id::text,'NULL')||'|'||revision FROM board_menu_panels WHERE panel_type='posting' ORDER BY chat_id, message_thread_id" || true
echo LINK_PANEL_DB_END
echo LINK_FEATURE_GATE_BEGIN
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT feature||'|'||CASE WHEN enabled THEN 'ENABLED' ELSE 'DISABLED' END FROM gaybbs_feature_release_gates WHERE feature='link'" || true
echo LINK_FEATURE_GATE_END
echo USERBOT_RESIDENT="$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service 2>/dev/null || true)"
